reason: The pay-on-delivery thing is what actually gets me to try it -- if my money sits held until I confirm the job is done right, that's real insurance against the usual horror story. I'll book once to test it, not switch my habits yet.
objection: How do I know this 'verified' freelancer is actually any good -- a badge and a rating number don't tell me if the ratings are real or just early reviews from the freelancer's own circle, and they've said themselves the pool near me is still small.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the completed-job counts and ratings near Chennai actually grow over a couple months, and reading real reviews in Tamil from people who sound like genuine customers, not planted ones.
